body.statement:
For fixed \(d\) and \(\lambda\), there are pairs
\[
(P_{0,T},P_{1,T})\subset
\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)
\]
with the declared marginal design-density bounds and geometric conditional beta-mixing envelope such that
\[
\inf_{N,T,\mathbf n}\int\min\{dP_{0,T},dP_{1,T}\}>0,
\qquad
|\tau_{n,P_{1,T}}(z_0)-\tau_{n,P_{0,T}}(z_0)|^2
\ge cR_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}.
\]
The event means are stable given the complete historical design, the historical errors are centered given that design, and both laws satisfy the maintained two-sided local modulus.  Consequently the spacing contribution to conditional minimax MSE is at least \(cR_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}\), and every uniformly conditionally \((1-\alpha)\)-honest interval has worst-case expected length at least \(c_\alpha R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}^{1/2}\).  Hence the logarithm in the uniform geometric-mixing spacing term is unavoidable without an additional anti-clustering restriction.
body.proof_tex:
Fix an interior \(z_0\) and a sufficiently small \(c_p>0\).  Let
\[
L_T=\lfloor c_L\log(T\vee2)\rfloor\vee1,
\qquad
p_T=c_p\frac{L_T}{T},
\]
where \(c_L>0\) is so small that \(c_L|\log\rho_0|<1\).  Then, after decreasing \(c_p\) if necessary,
\[
2p_T\le\beta_0\rho_0^{L_T-1}
\tag{55}
\]
for all sufficiently large \(T\).  Let \(A_T\) be a Euclidean ball centered at \(z_0\), contained in the cube, with Lebesgue measure \(p_T\).  Its radius obeys
\[
h_T\asymp p_T^{1/d}\asymp\left\{\frac{\log(T\vee2)}T\right\}^{1/d}.
\tag{56}
\]

Partition the calendar into deterministic consecutive blocks of length \(L_T\), apart from a final shorter block.  Independently over blocks draw \(G_b\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(p_T)\).  Conditional on \(G_b=1\), draw the block's design points independently and uniformly on \(A_T\); conditional on \(G_b=0\), draw them independently and uniformly on \([0,1]^d\setminus A_T\).  Since \(\operatorname{Leb}_d(A_T)=p_T\), each one-time marginal density equals
\[
p_T\frac{\mathbf1_{A_T}(x)}{p_T}
+(1-p_T)\frac{\mathbf1_{A_T^c}(x)}{1-p_T}=1.
\tag{57}
\]
Thus the density bounds hold after choosing their fixed envelope to contain one.

Sigma-fields separated by at least \(L_T\) depend on disjoint independent block variables.  At a smaller lag only a shared block can induce dependence.  Conditional on its binary state the two separated parts are independent; expansion of this two-component mixture bounds its absolute-regularity distance from the product law by \(2p_T(1-p_T)\le2p_T\).  Therefore (55) implies
\[
\beta_P(k\mid E_0)
\le
\begin{cases}
2p_T,&1\le k<L_T,\\
0,&k\ge L_T,
\end{cases}
\le\beta_0\rho_0^k.
\tag{58}
\]

Choose a bounded Holder carrier \(g\) in the interior of the response range.  For \(\lambda>1\), give \(g\) a nonzero affine component at \(z_0\); for \(0<\lambda\le1\), give it an asymmetric \(\lambda\)-cusp there.  Rescale it so its covariance-standardized modulus lies strictly between the declared lower and upper constants.  For a smooth bump \(\psi\) supported on the unit ball with \(\psi(0)=1\), set
\[
m_0(x)=g(x),
\qquad
m_1(x)=g(x)+c_bh_T^\lambda\psi((x-z_0)/h_T).
\tag{59}
\]
For sufficiently small fixed \(c_b>0\), both functions lie in \(\mathcal H_d(\lambda,L)\) and the response interior.  If \(\lambda>1\), the perturbation's increment is at most \(Cc_bh_T^{\lambda-1}\delta\) for \(\delta\le h_T\), and at most \(Cc_bh_T^\lambda\le Cc_bh_T^{\lambda-1}\delta\) for \(\delta>h_T\); it therefore cannot cancel the carrier's affine lower modulus.  If \(0<\lambda\le1\), its increment is at most \(Cc_b\delta^\lambda\), so it cannot cancel a fixed cusp lower modulus when \(c_b\) is small.  The Holder upper bound supplies the upper modulus.  Thus both laws obey \texttt{ass:local-two-sided-modulus} with \(\kappa=\min\{\lambda,1\}\).

Given the complete design, draw bounded errors independently across units, centered conditional on that design, with conditional variance at least \(B^{-1}\), and set historical response mean to \(m_\ell(X_{st})\) under law \(\ell\).  Draw bounded event outcomes independently of the design with a common mean under both laws.  Complete untreated event potential outcomes with cohort-average mean \(m_\ell(z_0)\).  Then
\[
\mathbb E[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid\mathscr X,E_0]
=\mathbb E[B_{si}^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid E_0],
\qquad
\mathbb E[\varepsilon_{sti}\mid\mathscr X,E_0]=0.
\tag{60}
\]
Hold all other cohorts, donors, and potential outcomes fixed across the laws and complete them inside the frozen envelopes.  Equations (57)--(60), together with consistency, no spillovers, limited anticipation, exact training coordinates, and event transport, place both laws in \(\mathcal M_{N,T,\mathbf n}^{\dagger}(\lambda)\).

Let \(\mathcal A_T\) be the event that no calendar block is active.  With \(T/L_T+O(1)\) blocks,
\[
P(\mathcal A_T\mid E_0)
=(1-p_T)^{T/L_T+O(1)}\longrightarrow e^{-c_p}>0.
\tag{61}
\]
On \(\mathcal A_T\), all design points lie outside \(A_T\), where the regressions in (59) agree.  The complete observed-data laws coincide there, so
\[
\int\min\{dP_{0,T},dP_{1,T}\}
\ge P(\mathcal A_T\mid E_0)\ge c>0.
\tag{62}
\]
The observed event mean is common, while event transport changes the untreated event mean by \(c_bh_T^\lambda\).  Substitution of these two facts directly into \texttt{def:target}, for a fixed positive-weight cohort, gives
\[
|\tau_{n,P_{1,T}}(z_0)-\tau_{n,P_{0,T}}(z_0)|
\ge ch_T^\lambda
\asymp\left\{\frac{\log(T\vee2)}T\right\}^{\lambda/d}.
\tag{63}
\]
The two-point squared-error calculation applied to (62)--(63) yields the \(cR_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}\) minimax lower bound.  Decreasing \(c_p\) makes the affinity in (62) exceed \(2\alpha+a_0\) for some \(a_0>0\); integrating simultaneous coverage against the overlap measure yields the \(c_\alpha R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}^{1/2}\) expected-length lower bound.  The construction uses no sequential-overlap or other anti-clustering premise.
body.justification: The explicit rare-block array is a generic-class certificate that the uniform logarithm is unavoidable.
body.gap: Marginal density and geometric beta mixing control long-range dependence but allow local states to occur in blocks of logarithmic length.
body.consumer: The iid spacing expression is retained only as a stricter-design comparator.
